audit.why: Chart reads Renekton for Levels 1 through 4-5 and Gwen for Level 6, First item and 2+ items, in both layers, matching the packet chart, the 51.49% win rate over 1138 games and the mirror (gwen__renekton, which set exactly those three rows to Gwen). Both layers agree row for row.
Spikes name the real timings — level 2-3 all-in, the 4-5 Mist-cooldown window, Needlework at 6, Riftmaker at two items — and match the chart's handover at 6.
audit.corrected: No change; the interaction detail was added to the surrounding fields instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Hallowed Mist as blanket untargetability ('she's safe inside it', 'your empowered W and Q hit nothing'). Riot's text is narrower and gives the counterplay the page never states: she can only be targeted by enemies outside the mist — anyone who walks into it can target her normally. So the answer to the Mist is to step in, not to wait it out. Its 22s rank-1 cooldown was never given, nor Snip Snip!'s true damage in the centre, nor that Skip 'n Slash grants attack range and on-hit magic damage and refunds part of its 13s cooldown on hit.
audit.why: Gwen W: 'summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist', 22/21/20/19/18. Q: 'deals true damage to units in the center'. E: 'gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage On-Hit ... cooldown is partially refunded', 13/12.5/12/11.5/11.
audit.corrected: The enter-the-mist counterplay stated in dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, whys[3] and wants.foe[0]; the true-damage cone in dontsFull[0].d; Skip 'n Slash's on-hit and refund in dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization line buys Executioner's Calling but explains it as 'his healing' — wrong pronoun and no source named.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her for a portion of the bonus damage dealt to champions, so the anti-heal is aimed at her passive.

edits.before: She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: She is untargetable only from outside — step into the mist and she is fair game.

edits.after: Hallowed Mist runs 22s and blocks targeting from outside only — walk into it and your W stun lands.

edits.before: Her Mist cooldown is your attack timer — bank Fury, track it, and all-in the moment it expires; she cannot disengage without it.
edits.after: Mist is 22s at rank 1 and only blocks targeting from outside — step inside it, land the 1.5s stun, and she has no disengage left.

edits.before: Cast Hallowed Mist the instant you E in so your empowered W and Q hit nothing and your Fury is wasted
edits.after: Cast Hallowed Mist as you E in and fight at its edge, so you must walk inside before you can touch her

edits.before: That is Gwen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.

edits.before: Trading at zero fury or overstaying after the burst — the second dash OUT is the half of the combo people forget.

notes: Chart was already correct in both layers and matched the mirror, so no chart edits here. The valuable fix was Hallowed Mist: the page told the player to wait the Mist out, when Riot's own text says anyone who enters the mist can target her — that changes the level 4-5 all-in from 'give up the window' to 'walk in and stun'. Carrying the mirror's open question forward: several Renekton pages describe Slice and Dice as a 'double dash' and Riot's kit text mentions only one dash; it does not appear in the fields I edited here, but it needs a human ruling once.
